description: This Java test class 'SudoIT' contains integration tests for the persistence layer of the 'thingsearch' service in the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests functionalities such as namespace count reports, sudo count queries, and metadata streaming for 'ThingId' objects, integrating with a MongoDB-based query builder and mock configurations.

classes.name: SudoIT
classes.description: A JUnit integration test class for testing the 'sudo' related persistence operations in the 'thingsearch' service of Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: createTestData
methods.description: Sets up test data before each test execution by inserting predefined 'Thing' entities.

methods.name: generateNamespaceCountReport
methods.description: Tests the generation of a namespace count report, validating the JSON output.

methods.name: sudoCount
methods.description: Validates the 'sudo count' query logic for different criteria such as any, by policyId, and nonexistent attributes.

methods.name: sudoStreamMetadata
methods.description: Tests streaming of metadata for specific 'ThingId' objects, verifying correct data retrieval.

methods.name: insertThings
methods.description: Helper method to insert test 'Thing' objects into the persistence layer for test setup.
